evidence.excerpt: This WYDOT Pocket Field Guide has been designed and developed to be used in the field for storm water management during construction
In Wyoming, the Department of Environmental Quality (DEQ) implements the storm water program under the Wyoming Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (WYPDES).
evidence.page_or_section: Wyoming Storm Water Permit for Construction Activities

evidence.excerpt: Pollution Controls and Best Management Practices for Storm Water During Construction FIELD GUIDE

This Field Guide includes: WYDOT specifications from the Standard Specifications for Road and Bridge Construction, WYDOT standard details from the Temporary Erosion Control Measures for Storm Water Pollution Prevention – Standard Plan Sheets.

BMPS FOR EROSION CONTROL GRADING TECHNIQUES... BMPS FOR SEDIMENT CONTROL PERIMETER CONTROL AND BARRIERS... VEHICLE TRACKING CONTROL PADS... BMPs FOR RECLAMATION... BMPs FOR MATERIALS, EQUIPMENT AND WASTE HANDLING... WASTE MANAGEMENT
Ditch Checks are designed to provide erosion control within man-made storm water conveyances such as ditches, channels, and swales.

extraction_quality.review_notes: Narrow construction-field pocket guide for BMP installation/inspection, not a hydrologic design manual. No design storm return periods, water quality volume method, peak-flow methods, or required modeling software appear in the text. Source PDF URL filename includes '4-6-11' (likely 2011-04-06) but no edition or effective date is stated in the extracted text, so dates were left null.

design_parameters.enrich_notes: WYDOT construction stormwater field guide focused on temporary erosion/sediment BMP installation and inspection (grading, perimeter controls, tracking pads, reclamation, spill/waste). No post-construction SCM sizing, WQv method, infiltration design rates, or canonical treatment practice design criteria appear in the excerpts.
